title: Conduvera GateExecutionKey (release D8_GATE_PROTOCOL)
description: Canonical, deterministic execution key for one gate execution. FROZEN DERIVATION: execution_key = lowercase-hex SHA-256 over the UTF-8 encoding of the compact JSON array [candidate_tree_sha, work_contract_digest, policy_digest, gate_semantic_digest, toolchain_digest, environment_digest, assurance_class], where each element is the component value EXACTLY as carried in `components`, JSON-string-encoded per RFC 8259 with separators ',' and ':' and no insignificant whitespace. Because assurance_class is a key component, two different assurance classes can NEVER share the same key; the same holds for toolchain and environment. Different assurance/toolchain/environment are never silently merged.

execution_key.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 per the frozen derivation above.
